key_idea: Distance from a point to an axis-aligned rectangle is the norm of the per-axis clamped offsets.
sketch: Compute dx = max(x1-x, 0, x-x2) and dy = max(y1-y, 0, y-y2), then print sqrt(dx^2+dy^2). This covers both the side case (one offset zero) and the corner case in one formula. O(1); print with enough decimals.
